vfairness.evaluation.vfairness_metrics.c.judgement: Run 2026-10-01. Healthy 300/200/100 rows: every rate, min_ratio, its pair and max_difference equal hand computation to 1e-12. One group, no rows, every prediction missing, every group label missing: min_ratio NaN, pair None, headline_basis no_pair. Nobody selected anywhere: NaN (0/0), never 1.0. A group selected nobody: 0.0 for that pair, a TRUE measurement of total exclusion. A 2-row group is marked invalid, kept out of the headline, and now named in the new headline_excluded_groups field (previously visible only by walking rates). Consumers (MCP tool, pulse orchestrator) pass the full result on.
